scenario: t0-beta weights load in an older alpha-only runtime without an error; outputs remain numerically plausible.
detection: Validate runtime minimum and checkpoint config conventions before loading; compare pinned reference fixture.
response: Reject unsupported combination and preserve last qualified forecast.
test_assertion: An older runtime/config mismatch never reaches a successful forecast status even if finite values are produced.
residual_limit: A matching version does not establish calibration or numerical parity across accelerators.

scenario: Operator upgrades Toto 1 to 2 for reported accuracy while a staffing-ramp future feature remains configured.
mechanism: New major version currently lacks exogenous-variable support despite older version having it.
detection: Resolve capability by checkpoint+adapter version; required-feature schema comparison.
response: Keep eligible old version or choose qualified alternative; never silently discard feature.
test_assertion: Upgrade with unsupported required future covariates fails validation or exposes an explicitly history-only scenario.
residual_limit: Supported covariates can still be uninformative or misleading.
requirement_source: Master plan context-to-forecast handoff; Toto current repository

scenario: Batch scheduler combines research, product and another tenant or changes batch size while keeping request data unchanged.
mechanism: Cross-learning/group attention uses batch membership as model input, altering forecasts or leaking cross-tenant signal.
detection: Persist grouping IDs/membership; reject cross-tenant groups; invariance tests for independent batching.
response: Make semantic groups explicit and stable; separate tenant workloads; backtest grouped variants.
test_assertion: Independent forecasts invariant to unrelated batch entries; joint forecast includes auditable group membership and never another tenant.
residual_limit: Within-tenant groups may exhibit negative transfer after reorganization.
requirement_source: Master plan team scope; Chronos-2 pipeline warning

scenario: Apache wrapper downloads TimesFM 3 or current Moirai weights into an enterprise production worker; Timestral customer crosses revenue threshold.
mechanism: Code license confused with weights license, or model eligibility changes with organization/deployment conditions.
detection: Registry stores separate license identifiers, license snapshot and deployment eligibility, with no wrapper inheritance.
response: Block ineligible deployment; use a qualified model/service or obtain separate permitted terms.
test_assertion: Apache code alone cannot qualify restrictive weights; eligibility checks cover the actual model artifact and use mode.
residual_limit: Rights for historical copies or custom contracts require their own evidence.
requirement_source: Master plan enterprise product objective; official TimesFM, Moirai, Timestral license sources

scenario: Finance asks for month-remainder P90; model returns 9 or 21 daily quantiles and implementation sums daily P90. A daily expected-spend path is separately filled from the median or simple average of reported quantiles.
mechanism: Marginal quantile addition discards temporal/cross-team dependence; extreme tails may be interpolated/extrapolated. A finite marginal quantile grid also does not identify the expected mean.
detection: Output contract states marginal versus joint samples; prohibit unsupported quantile arithmetic. Declare native point statistic and mean availability/derivation assumptions.
response: Use qualified aggregate-distribution method or label an uncalibrated scenario; preserve native quantile grid and tail method. A mean-dependent path must use a qualified mean estimator and preserve its integration, sample and tail assumptions.
test_assertion: Cumulative risk output cannot be marked calibrated solely from a sum of per-step quantiles. A median or arbitrary quantile-grid average cannot be labeled expected spend without a qualified derivation.
residual_limit: Correct sample aggregation still needs dependence and aggregate calibration.
requirement_source: Master plan supported uncertainty handoff; model output contracts

scenario: A delayed launch plan is supplied as known future staffing while backtest uses the final approved document or actual future usage proxy.
mechanism: Hindsight features make an ordinary forecast resemble GIFT-Eval-CTX oracle effects.
detection: Feature knowledge-time <= forecast origin; feature evidence snapshot; identify oracle versus predicted covariate.
response: Treat unconfirmed plans as scenarios; evaluate event occurrence separately and use as-of documents.
test_assertion: Replacing a document after origin cannot alter the stored historical forecast or its backtest inputs.
residual_limit: Even timestamp-safe plans can fail or lack measured spend effects.
requirement_source: Master plan superseded-plan example; GIFT-Eval-CTX scope

scenario: BigQuery alias silently stays at default 2.5; app claims multivariate 3, ignores longer history, and projects preview pricing after Dec 1.
mechanism: Service limits/defaults/pricing differ from local research family and change over time.
detection: Explicit service model parameter and limits; response metadata; pricing effective dates.
response: Pin/select supported model, expose truncation, re-estimate cost before pricing transition.
test_assertion: Request logs identify selected model; >2048 context for 3 reports truncation; cost estimates carry effective date.
residual_limit: Preview service and commercial terms may change before implementation.
requirement_source: Master plan periods/assumptions; BigQuery AI.FORECAST reference

scenario: New team has two reported days and 28 absent days; zero fill or batch padding resembles a dormant team followed by a spike.
mechanism: Absence, pre-existence padding, actual zero and reporting delay collapse into one numeric pattern.
detection: Separate creation date, observation mask, padding mask and source completeness; effective-history check.
response: Choose qualified short-history forecast, peer prior/scenario or unavailable; do not pretend zero-shot means history-free.
test_assertion: Missing and pre-existence cells never become observed zeros; confidence status reflects actual usable history.
residual_limit: No reviewed model guarantees reliable zero-history spend inference.
requirement_source: Master plan measured/estimated/completeness boundaries; t0 mask contract

scenario: TimeGPT sample request is split across batches for scale and downstream treats concatenated paths as company-wide jointly coupled samples.
mechanism: Partitioning breaks cross-series coupling; same sample_id alone does not establish joint dependence.
detection: Persist service coupled flag and partition manifest; assert joint requirement before dispatch.
response: Use permitted unpartitioned joint request or explicitly model/calibrate dependence elsewhere.
test_assertion: Partitioned uncoupled paths cannot receive a joint-company probability label.
residual_limit: Coupled=true does not prove correct correlations in enterprise data.
requirement_source: Master plan company/team forecast handoff; current Nixtla simulate client

scenario: Moirai2 adapter accepts multivariate dimensions and covariate arguments, so integration marks it fully supported without a shape/capability check.
mechanism: Public source carries univariate-only and multivariate-untested notes despite broader-looking parameters.
detection: Document evidence tier; exercise independent target/feature perturbation and alignment fixtures before qualification.
response: Keep univariate qualified scope or mark unsupported until verified; no silent reshape.
test_assertion: A registry entry cannot claim tested multivariate behavior based solely on constructor arguments.
residual_limit: Passing functional fixtures does not establish predictive value.
requirement_source: Master plan supported-scenario contract; Uni2TS moirai2 forecast source
